name: Bossier Parish, LA
findings: Bossier Parish has 281 nonprofit organizations. 110 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bossier Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
